    if emb_table is not None:
        return int(emb_table.x.shape[0]), int(trainer.mesh.shape["expert"])
    ep = max(int(getattr(trainer, "training_ep", 0) or 0), 1)
    return int(trainer.dataset.input_vocab_size), ep
